**document id:** `sh-j2-judgment-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** judgment | **related:** judgment officers, contact, orientation | **cross-reference:** `judgment_officer_profession.md`; `contact.md`

judgment officers are human case owners and roving intellectual commissions, not analysts at the end of a queue. a working portfolio is approximately five live problems: four directed and one mandatory, bounded self-directed curiosity problem. the officer states why it matters and closes/hands it off before opening another.

each consequential problem has a short commission stating the question without implying the answer. within legal/security boundaries the jo may speak directly across sable harbor, attend ordinary operations, visit sites, sit with collectors, ride with jag, engage technical/external experts, request records or collection through contact, hold open problem hours, and protect sensitive sources. the jo has no line command: power compels institutional attention to a question, not operational action.

the living **problem book** answers: what am i trying to understand? what do i believe and why? what does not make sense? what next? what would change my mind? “things that do not make sense” remains explicit. jag handoff and problem transfer require conversation/read-back, not ticket reassignment.

at the judgment table, other officers professionally attack a consequential judgment. it is not a vote; the originator remains responsible and dissents travel. closure may be resolved, superseded, merged, unresolvable with available evidence, or premise invalid without excessive bureaucracy.

**judgment watch** is a small judgment function physically/operationally at contact intake. it preserves raw signals, correlates weak signals, routes material, and proposes new problems but never owns the resulting problem.

a private longitudinal self-knowledge record supports calibration and blind-spot learning, not gamified ranking or punishment. volume and throughput are poor primary measures; management asks whether the officer is getting closer to truth.

objects.title: ORIENTATION — INSTITUTIONAL MENTAL MODEL
objects.search_text:
orientation — institutional mental model docs/j2/orientation.md # orientation — institutional mental model

**document id:** `sh-j2-orient-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation | **related:** eib, canon, executive/board/finance placement | **cross-reference:** `orientation_officer_profession.md`; `eib_and_enterprise_questions.md`

orientation owns the eib, enterprise questions and assumptions, changes of mind, reorientation, consequential dissent travel, intellectual history, learning-to-education identification, canon, and epistemic integrity in executive/board decisions. it does not own collection, investigations, line strategy, it, generic communications, execution follow-up, command, or internal audit.

orientation lives close to j2 hq, ceo, and board interface. an officer may intervene when material uncertainty is presented as fact, dissent omitted, confidence overstated, or a known information deficiency matters. the officer does not vote, direct outcome, automatically delay, or own the agenda. “noted and proceeding” is valid.

## vocation and anti-court bargain

approximately 20–25 commissioned officers is the working target; trainees/fellows may sit outside it. possible officer/senior/distinguished ranks are provisional. in exchange for compensation, access, freedom, research, sabbaticals, field exposure, education, and prestige, an ordinary commissioned officer permanently gives up later c-suite line office, operating vp authority, voting board membership, and equivalent decision power. whether a former head may later become a nonexecutive director remains open.

officers do not supervise line staff, own operating deliverables/budgets, conduct personnel actions, gatekeep executives/calendars, broker politics, map who is “up/down,” keep private intelligence for leverage, claim “we” for executive decisions, or turn access into future power. material institutional information returns through proper channels. alexandria preserves judgments/dissents/assumptions/decisions, not a forensic blame graph of interpersonal influence.

executive assignments rotate roughly 24–36 months and are styled “orientation officer assigned to the office of the ceo,” never a person's possession. most officers also work enterprise questions, eib, canon, field immersion, research, education, and study tours.

## coverage

the office of ceo and board each have separate dedicated officers. the board officer attends key board/committee meetings, may meet independent directors appropriately, and prevents exclusively management-filtered understanding without becoming gotcha compliance. finance has a permanent senior cfo-office presence plus approximately 2–3 working embeds (exact placement count refinable). temporary coverage follows consequential decision environments such as acquisition, red wash expansion, major capital programs, or new regulated exposure—not prestige.

finance embeds observe beliefs becoming numbers while models are built, test ownership/provenance of assumptions, compare actuals to the belief beneath the variance, create/reopen judgment problems when material, and leave the spreadsheet to see operations.

orientation orients itself through a named head/director and professional challenge, not a steering committee. the head is first among rigor, not czar of truth.

objects.title: JUNCTION ADVISORY GROUP — FIELD DOCTRINE
objects.search_text:
junction advisory group — field doctrine docs/j2/junction_advisory_group.md # junction advisory group — field doctrine

**document id:** `sh-j2-jag-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** junction advisory group | **related:** contact, judgment, willow, education | **cross-reference:** `contact_collection_management.md`; `judgment_officer_profession.md`; `education.md`

each standard jag team has exactly five billets: senior management-track **team lead**, quantitative **data scientist**, software/systems-heavy **technical systems advisor**, line/field **operational advisor**, and human-factors/culture/incentives **human systems advisor**. research is everyone's job; no generic research-analyst seat is added.

```mermaid
flowchart tb
  tl[team lead] --- ds[data scientist]
  tl --- ts[technical systems advisor]
  tl --- oa[operational advisor]
  tl --- hs[human systems advisor]
```

the roughly one-year tour has: a 30–45 day first embed to learn/observe/map/build relationships; several months at j2/willow/experts building and testing; a 30–45 day return embed to implement/test against reality; and approximately 90 days stewarding lessons, teaching, mentoring, updating j2, and supporting course/team redesign.

teams belong to j2, rotate rather than attach permanently, and target roughly two touches per business line per year. six active teams (about 30 billets) is working scale. later teams deliberately test earlier intervention with fresh eyes. this is not consulting tourism.

j2 may surge a team for crisis, serious failure, major adverse finding/board dissent, or consequential uncertainty. it may appear to the board as fact witness, ground-truth collector, or conditions investigator. jag does not arbitrate, command, audit, or punish. it returns evidence/context, supports willow reach-back, and transfers context to the relevant jo in person.

## team philosophy and billet contribution

the team lead is a senior management-track professional in the post-senior-manager/pre-national-enterprise-leadership career stage. the tour is a career-making broadening assignment because the lead must see across the company without acquiring line command over the host.

the data scientist investigates quantitatively and tests whether patterns survive disciplined analysis. the technical systems advisor understands software, development, interfaces, and system behavior. the operational advisor tests whether a proposed idea survives actual line or field execution. the human systems advisor studies human factors, organizational behavior, culture, incentives, and why organizations behave as they do; the role is not generic hr. research belongs to all five billets, so no generic research-analyst seat is added.

## deployment compact

before deployment, j2 states the question, host environment, access/safety boundaries, relationships to live judgment problems and contact requirements, and expected handoffs without predetermining conclusions. the host understands that jag observes and assists but does not evaluate personnel or take command.

the first 30–45 day embed privileges learning, observation, mapping, problem discovery, and human trust. the middle build period uses j2, willow, and relevant experts to create and test interventions. the second 30–45 day embed returns to implement or test and determine whether the idea survives reality. the final approximately 90 days preserves lessons, teaches, mentors, updates j2, supports course redesign, and helps other teams.

two different jag touches per business line per year is a working operating aim, not two permanently assigned teams. rotation creates constructive replication: a later team tests what happened with fresh eyes. teams belong to j2 and cannot become a host leader's private staff.

## surge and board fact-finding

a surge is scoped to conditions and evidence. in a crisis, serious failure, adverse finding, board dissent, or consequential uncertainty, jag can establish what is occurring, what people are seeing, what artifacts exist, and which context is missing. before the board, it speaks as fact witness or collector, clearly separating observation, source report, analysis, and uncertainty. it does not arbitrate the dispute or recommend itself into authority.

## willow and closure

jag provides a direct route from operating reality to willow technical support where a bounded experiment or build is appropriate. willow does not turn the host into an uncontrolled laboratory; jag does not promise a technical solution before evidence. closure includes host read-back, evidence transfer to contact/judgment, intervention outcome, follow-up ownership, reusable lesson disposition, and education handoff where warranted.

objects.title: J2 EDUCATION
objects.search_text:
j2 education docs/j2/education.md # j2 education

**document id:** `sh-j2-edu-001` | **version:** 1.1.0 | **effective:** september 3, 2026 | **state:** locked
**owner:** j2 education | **related:** orientation, canon, eib, jag, decision quality | **cross-reference:** `orientation.md`; `orientation_officer_profession.md`; `../governance/decision_quality_and_after_action_learning.md`

education is a separate j2 arm tightly coupled to orientation. its primary mission is enterprise-wide education, while it also serves as the professional schoolhouse for j2 itself. education is both an institution and a physical place: a serious learning campus and conference center with classrooms, residential capacity, case rooms, mock executive and board environments, and space for convening across sable harbor.

education owns teaching practice: deep corporate and role education, business-line literacy, learning paths, cases, lessons learned, mandatory compliance education, executive formation, j2 professional formation, exercises, and the conversion of important learning into usable instruction.

legal, safety, hr, and compliance may own requirements, subject matter, and required legal content. j2 education owns pedagogy, instructional/delivery design, relevance, engagement, and connection to real work. sexual-harassment, workplace-violence, safety, compliance, assurance, and technical education receive the same standard of excellence; mandatory never means intentionally lifeless.

## four missions

1. **enterprise education.** make sable harbor legible to its people and raise institutional literacy across business lines and headquarters.
2. **executive formation.** give newly appointed senior executives, business heads, corporate officers, and selected headquarters leaders a common grounding in sable harbor's institutions, decision system, history, responsibilities, and realities.
3. **j2 professional formation.** train and continuously develop contact, judgment, orientation, jag, and education professionals, including specialist schools, exercises, apprenticeships, and continuing professional education.
4. **convening.** operate a serious enterprise conference center where difficult problems, cross-business learning, after-action work, research, and professional communities can meet away from normal headquarters rhythms.

## educational constitution

education makes sable harbor legible to its people. institutional literacy includes why the company exists, how its business lines actually operate, where authority sits, how evidence becomes judgment, how physical reality constrains models, and how lessons change institutional behavior. deep learning and mandatory learning belong to one profession because both require respect for the learner and fidelity to reality.

education converts doctrine and operational learning into instruction without claiming ownership of the underlying law, safety rule, control, technical truth, or business decision. subject-matter owners approve required content. education challenges incoherent, irrelevant, or pedagogically ineffective material and designs delivery, practice, assessment, reinforcement, and refresh.

## program families

education maintains five standing program families:

- **sable harbor formation:** institutional literacy for headquarters staff, selected business leaders, and other roles whose work requires understanding the enterprise beyond a single function.
- **executive formation:** a residential, case-based program for newly appointed senior leaders. a one-week course is the default design point, with extensions where role complexity warrants.
- **j2 professional education:** entry formation and continuing education for contact, judgment, orientation, jag, and education staff.
- **enterprise professional programs:** advanced courses in reasoning, evidence, decision quality, postmortems, business-line literacy, technical subjects, and other capabilities that materially improve institutional performance.
- **convenings and exercises:** conferences, simulations, cross-business problem sessions, case immersions, and controlled decision exercises.

residential attendance is not universal. it is expected for j2 entrants, new corporate officers, business heads, and selected headquarters roles where the value of immersion justifies removal from ordinary work.

## learning products

the arm maintains role pathways, business-line literacy, technical deep dives, cases, field-derived lessons, leadership learning, and mandatory curricula. a case preserves uncertainty and decision context rather than flattening history into a moral with an obvious answer. when lawful, learners encounter the evidence, assumptions, dissent, and consequences that made the situation real.

blackridge is part of the institutional case canon and may be used both openly and in disguised form where preserving uncertainty improves learning. education may also build high-fidelity simulated boardrooms, executive offices, operations rooms, interview rooms, and crisis environments for professional formation and orientation assessment and selection.

learning effectiveness is not completion alone. evidence may include recall, application, changed field behavior, reduced repeated error, better escalation, improved question quality, and learner feedback. education does not manipulate these into vanity metrics.

## staffing and faculty model

the permanent education establishment is approximately **35 billets**. the permanent core includes the head of education, deputy leadership, senior faculty, instructors, exercise and case designers, program/registrar staff, learning operations, and campus/program support.

the permanent core is intentionally supplemented by rotating practitioners from contact, judgment, orientation, jag, headquarters functions, and operating businesses. education does not build a giant detached faculty when current practitioners can teach from real work. rotating faculty remain subject-matter contributors; education retains ownership of pedagogy and instructional quality.

the campus itself may support substantially more people than the permanent thirty-five-person establishment because facilities, hospitality, events, and shared enterprise services can scale independently of the teaching corps.

## relationship to orientation and jag

orientation identifies changes in institutional understanding that require education. jag returns field context, reusable practices, failed interventions, and teaching material through human handoff. education may support the final stewardship phase of a jag tour and may send instructors into operating environments to understand the work being taught.

education owns the assessment and selection environment for orientation candidates under the standards of the orientation profession. it maintains the physical and instructional infrastructure, role-player pool, case library, safeguards, and exercise integrity while orientation owns admission standards and final commissioning decisions.

objects.title: ENTERPRISE INTELLIGENCE BRIEF AND EDGE REPORTING STANDARD
objects.search_text:
enterprise intelligence brief and edge reporting standard docs/j2/eib_and_enterprise_questions.md # enterprise intelligence brief and edge reporting standard

**document id:** `sh-j2-eib-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation | **related:** canon, judgment, contact, pinakes | **cross-reference:** `orientation.md`; `alexandria/canon_institutional_knowledge.md`; `alexandria/pinakes_portal_and_ux.md`

the eib is normally approximately two pages, enterprise-visible by default, a navigational front door rather than the house, and discussed rather than read aloud. each category contains no more than five linked items: **what sable harbor currently believes; what changed our mind; what doesn't fit; what we're arguing about; what we wish we knew.** items drill into alexandria; evidence may remain restricted.

sable harbor maintains a short set of important enterprise questions, priority requirements, and plain-language “tell j2 if you see this” triggers. every employee has the right and duty to contribute relevant signal. a submission is evidence, not institutional truth. material signals receive documented disposition—no screaming into a void. the question stays visible whenever lawful even if relevant evidence is restricted.

## form and editorial standard

the brief normally occupies approximately two pages. each of its five categories contains no more than five items. compression is disciplined selection, not removal of dissent or uncertainty. each item states the point, why it matters now, confidence/state where material, and a route into deeper alexandria material. restricted evidence may remain restricted while the question and properly releasable institutional position remain visible.

**what sable harbor currently believes** contains consequential current beliefs or assumptions, not a corporate-news digest. **what changed our mind** identifies the evidence or judgment that moved understanding and the prior state it superseded. **what doesn't fit** preserves anomalies that resist the current model. **what we're arguing about** presents genuine competing interpretations and serious dissent. **what we wish we knew** exposes the highest-value unknowns and intelligence requirements.

orientation owns selection, synthesis, dissent integrity, and publication. the briefer does not read the page aloud or convert it into a conclusion-delivery ritual. the eib starts discussion, invites edge knowledge, and gives employees a navigational front door into institutional reasoning.

## enterprise-wide access and sensing

the newest aru hire should be able to see the same core questions as senior leadership unless the nature of information requires restriction. that employee may recognize a local observation leadership cannot see and becomes an institutional sensor. submissions travel to contact intake, retain raw signal, and receive a disposition through judgment watch or the relevant problem owner.

priority questions and “tell j2 if you see this” triggers are written in plain language and specify useful observations without encouraging universal surveillance or accusation. a contributor does not become responsible for deciding whether the signal is true or enterprise-significant.

every issued eib remains in the pinakes eib archive. later correction or changed belief links to, rather than overwrites, the earlier brief so a historical reader can reconstruct the institutional state.

objects.title: INFORMATION ACCESS DOCTRINE
objects.search_text:
information access doctrine docs/j2/information_access_doctrine.md # information access doctrine

**document id:** `sh-j2-access-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked
**owner:** corporate governance / j2 headquarters | **related:** immaculate intelligence, disclosure | **cross-reference:** `alexandria/information_access_and_disclosure.md`; `j2_charter.md`

**maximum useful visibility. minimum necessary restriction.** default access is open. restriction is driven by information nature—not rank—including personal information, privilege, active m&a, and narrowly compartmented regulated/federal material.

questions are common property and propagate wider than answers. where lawful and appropriate, a user may see that relevant material exists but is restricted. restriction creates named ownership, reason, challenge path, review, and duration/reconsideration. a failure to get knowledge to someone who needed it is investigated as an intelligence-system failure, not merely hr/it administration. security and iam implement this doctrine; they do not define it.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA CHARTER: TEMPORAL INTEGRITY, PROVENANCE, AND LINEAGE
objects.search_text:
alexandria charter: temporal integrity, provenance, and lineage docs/j2/alexandria/alexandria_charter.md # alexandria charter: temporal integrity, provenance, and lineage

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-001` | **version:** 1.0.1 | **revised:** september 6, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation | **related:** temporal integrity, provenance, connection, search | **cross-reference:** `temporal_integrity.md`; `provenance_and_lineage.md`; `institutional_memory_and_connection.md`

**revision authority:** the [september 6 canon closeout addendum](../../canon/decision_register_addendum_2026-09-06_closeout.md) locks desktop usability with planned future ar and vr integration. it supersedes uncertainty about whether those future interfaces are intended, not the open details of their implementation or the historical scope of earlier approvals.

alexandria **preserves** what sable harbor believed, when, why, and what changed; **connects** questions, evidence, judgments, decisions, outcomes, finance, business lines, jag, and learning; and **orients** users to what is current, disputed, unresolved, historical, or superseded. machine suggestions never silently become facts.

## time

records distinguish where applicable: event time; recorded time; institutional-access time; understood time; and institutional-change time. queries must separately support “what did sable harbor actually know on date x?” and “what information existed or could reasonably have been known on date x?” later knowledge may explain an earlier state, never silently backfill it. current/active, superseded, disputed, historical, and unresolved states remain human-legible without status-code excess.

## provenance

“source that” traverses canon, eib, judgment, decision, semaphore, or daedalus synthesis toward evidence where access permits. lineage represents supporting, contrary, missing, contested, and considered/rejected evidence. a dead-end chain remains useful history. source-supported statements and ai inference are visibly distinct.

## access and retention boundary

information access follows `../information_access_doctrine.md`. raw collection is most heavily gated. restrictions may preserve visible questions/existence notices without disclosure. exact entitlement roles, technology stack, and retention/deletion implementation remain open; no “never delete” promise overrides later law or privacy duties.

## desktop usability and planned ar/vr integration

alexandria must remain fully usable through an ordinary desktop interface. future augmented-reality (ar) and virtual-reality (vr) integration is planned, and the architecture must support those future interfaces. headsets and spatial hardware are never prerequisites for ordinary use; ar/vr is not a v0.1 dependency.

these are interfaces to the same institutional environment, not new institutions or sources of authority. they must preserve the same access, disclosure, provenance, temporal-integrity, and human-authorship boundaries as the desktop experience. visual prominence cannot create truth, consensus, or authority, and spatial presentation cannot expose restricted relationships.

specific devices, vendors, interface implementations, and delivery dates remain open. this planned direction makes no claim that ar or vr capability already exists. see [visualization and branching history](visualization_and_branching_history.md).

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA INSTITUTIONAL MEMORY AND CONNECTION
objects.search_text:
alexandria institutional memory and connection docs/j2/alexandria/institutional_memory_and_connection.md # alexandria institutional memory and connection

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-memory-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation | **related:** canon, provenance, temporal integrity, search | **cross-reference:** `canon_institutional_knowledge.md`; `provenance_and_lineage.md`; `temporal_integrity.md`

## constitutional promise

alexandria exists so sable harbor does not lose what it learns. preservation means more than retaining documents. the environment preserves what the institution believed, when, why, with what confidence and dissent, and what later changed. a superseded state remains part of institutional memory rather than an embarrassment to erase.

## connected institutional record

sable harbor's world is not a folder tree. a question can touch a judgment problem, contact requirement, field observation, finance assumption, board decision, jag deployment, business line, incident, lesson, course, canon state, and later outcome. alexandria maintains those relationships so a person can move through the institutional mind rather than guess which department filed the answer.

connection is explicit and typed where useful: supports, contradicts, qualifies, relies on, supersedes, corrects, prompted, resulted in, observed at, applies to, taught by, and remains unresolved by. relationships preserve author/source, time, confidence, access boundary, and status. the system avoids an ornate ontology whose complexity exceeds human value; connection serves navigation and reasoning.

machine intelligence may propose a potential relationship, anomaly, or cluster. a suggestion remains synthetic until a human professional accepts it into the appropriate institutional artifact. repeated co-occurrence is not causation, and graph proximity is not institutional belief.

## memory of error

later evidence can explain why an earlier belief failed, but it cannot silently edit the prior state. contrary evidence, rejected paths, dead ends, and dissent remain traversable when lawful. this protects decision-quality review from hindsight and allows future officers to see whether a failed path was unreasonable, unknowable, or simply unlucky.

## continuity

human handovers, officer transfers, leadership succession, acquisitions, and business-line change use alexandria to carry context. a record is not “preserved” if its links, provenance, access, or contemporary meaning are lost. orientation stewards this continuity; owning functions remain responsible for human authorship and the substance of their records.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA SEARCH AND HISTORICAL RECONSTRUCTION
objects.search_text:
alexandria search and historical reconstruction docs/j2/alexandria/search_and_historical_reconstruction.md # alexandria search and historical reconstruction

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-search-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation / alexandria stewardship | **related:** pinakes, temporal integrity, provenance, daedalus | **cross-reference:** `pinakes_portal_and_ux.md`; `temporal_integrity.md`; `provenance_and_lineage.md`

## search as institutional navigation

alexandria search is built for people who may not know the repository name, owning function, final terminology, or perfect query. a future employee searching `transportation scheduling` should be able to enter years of relevant questions, evidence, traffic, judgments, decisions, outcomes, jag observations, finance assumptions, business-line material, and learning—subject to access.

search operates across full text and structured relationships: subject, topic, business line, entity/asset where applicable, related decision, judgment problem, collection requirement, author/origin, time dimensions, current state, supersession/correction, confidence, dissent, and reference thread. results distinguish authoritative records, evidence, and daedalus synthetic material.

rabbit holes are a feature when provenance and orientation remain visible. a user can hold an item, follow references, move backward to sources, move forward to reliance/outcomes, compare periods or businesses, and return to the original question without losing the investigative trail.

## historical reconstruction

“take me to what we knew on the morning of x” reconstructs the accessible institutional state then: records available, understanding formed, current canon, live judgments and dissent, unresolved gaps, and decisions already made. it excludes later knowledge unless clearly shown as a later explanatory overlay.

a separate knowability inquiry identifies information that existed or could reasonably have been accessed at the time even if sable harbor had not found, routed, or understood it. the system never collapses actual knowledge and possible knowledge into one hindsight narrative.

## restricted results

search does not become an entitlement bypass. questions and existence notices may travel wider than evidence, but result counts, snippets, relationship graphs, comparisons, and daedalus answers must not leak protected content or enable prohibited inference. the exact retrieval engine and authorization implementation remain open; this doctrine defines acceptance behavior.

## quality

search quality is judged by relevant discovery, provenance preservation, temporal correctness, understandable status, and safe disclosure—not clicks, query volume, or the appearance of a single definitive answer.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA VISUALIZATION AND BRANCHING HISTORY
objects.search_text:
alexandria visualization and branching history docs/j2/alexandria/visualization_and_branching_history.md # alexandria visualization and branching history

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-vis-001` | **version:** 1.0.1 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **revised:** september 6, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation / alexandria stewardship | **related:** connection, provenance, temporal integrity, daedalus | **cross-reference:** `institutional_memory_and_connection.md`; `provenance_and_lineage.md`; `daedalus_personal_instance_and_workspace.md`

**revision authority:** the [september 6 canon closeout addendum](../../canon/decision_register_addendum_2026-09-06_closeout.md) supersedes the earlier tentative spatial/ar direction with planned future ar and vr integration while preserving desktop usability. earlier records remain historical; implementation details remain open.

visualization helps a person reason about institutional time and connection; it is not decorative dashboarding. alexandria and daedalus may present timelines, branching histories, connection maps, evidence lineage, assumption dependence, cross-business comparison, and git-like branches of institutional understanding.

a timeline distinguishes event, record, access, understanding, and institutional-change times where material. a branch view shows competing interpretations, the evidence each relied upon, dissent, merge or supersession, and what remained unresolved. a lineage view moves from institutional statement toward sources and from an assumption toward later decisions and outcomes.

visual prominence does not create authority. node size, color, proximity, centrality, or machine-suggested connection must not imply truth, consensus, causation, importance, or access that the underlying record does not support. every visual element remains traceable to its source/state, and restricted relationships cannot be exposed through shape or absence.

daedalus can assemble persistent user-side investigative visuals. they are marked synthetic and non-authoritative, remain outside alexandria, and cannot promote themselves into canon, semaphore, judgment, or eib. a human may independently author an institutional visual under the applicable process.

## planned ar and vr interfaces

future augmented-reality (ar) and virtual-reality (vr) integration is planned, and alexandria's architecture must support it. alexandria remains fully usable through an ordinary desktop interface; headsets and spatial hardware are never prerequisites for ordinary use. ar/vr is not a v0.1 dependency.

spatial interaction must serve understanding: exploring relationships, chronology, physical locations, evidence lineage, and competing interpretations. the constitutional requirement is faithful, navigable representation of time, provenance, disagreement, and connection regardless of interface technology. ar and vr are optional interfaces for the user, not separate institutions or a change to alexandria's authority.

the same access, disclosure, provenance, temporal-integrity, and authorship rules apply in every interface. a spatial view cannot expose a relationship the viewer is not entitled to see; visual prominence cannot imply truth or consensus. daedalus-generated investigative visuals retain their non-authoritative marking and cannot promote themselves into institutional records.

no specific device, vendor, implementation, or delivery date is committed. the direction is planned, not a claim that ar or vr integration is already implemented.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA TEMPORAL INTEGRITY
objects.search_text:
alexandria temporal integrity docs/j2/alexandria/temporal_integrity.md # alexandria temporal integrity

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-time-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked
**owner:** orientation / alexandria stewardship | **related:** canon, semaphore, provenance, historical reconstruction | **cross-reference:** `canon_institutional_knowledge.md`; `search_and_historical_reconstruction.md`

time is a first-class property, not one timestamp. where applicable alexandria distinguishes when an event happened, when it was recorded, when sable harbor could access it, when a person or function understood it, and when it changed institutional understanding.

these dimensions answer different questions. event time reconstructs reality; recorded time shows the contemporary artifact; access time constrains what the institution could use; understood time shows when meaning formed; institutional-change time identifies when canon, eib, a judgment, decision, model, or question actually moved.

the environment must support both:

- **what did sable harbor actually know on date x?** this uses institutional records, access, understanding, confidence, and dissent as they stood then.
- **what information existed or could reasonably have been known on date x?** this may include evidence then available but not yet found, routed, understood, or incorporated.

those answers must not be conflated to reward or blame with hindsight. later knowledge may annotate and explain an earlier record, create a correction, or supersede a state. it may never silently revise the earlier state as though sable harbor always knew. the institution remembers being wrong faithfully.

current/active, disputed, unresolved, historical, corrected, and superseded states must be navigable. a state transition preserves predecessor, effective/change time, human author, reason, evidence, dissent, and downstream relationships. legal/privacy deletion requirements may later remove content, but the architecture does not promise unlawful “never delete”; retention implementation remains open.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA PROVENANCE AND LINEAGE
objects.search_text:
alexandria provenance and lineage docs/j2/alexandria/provenance_and_lineage.md # alexandria provenance and lineage

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-prov-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation / alexandria stewardship | **related:** temporal integrity, connection, search, daedalus | **cross-reference:** `temporal_integrity.md`; `institutional_memory_and_connection.md`; `search_and_historical_reconstruction.md`

nothing important should require blind trust. “source that” must work from canon, eib, judgment, decision, semaphore traffic, or daedalus synthesis toward underlying evidence wherever the user's access permits.

lineage preserves the originating artifact or observation; collector and method; relevant event/record/access times; transformations; citations and references; author and accountable judgment owner; confidence and assumptions; supporting, contrary, missing, contested, and considered/rejected evidence; corrections; supersession; and downstream reliance.

provenance is not a single “source url.” it makes clear what a source is authoritative for and where authority ends. a finance ledger may establish what was booked without proving physical occurrence; a field observation may establish local conditions without proving enterprise prevalence; an expert may provide a hypothesis without institutional authority.

dead ends remain useful. an abandoned hypothesis, rejected source, or superseded chain stays historically navigable when lawful because it explains why sable harbor once believed something and prevents repeated unproductive work.

machine intelligence may suggest relationships, anomalies, or likely lineage. a human must decide whether those connections enter an institutional record. daedalus visibly distinguishes source-supported statements, direct quotations/retrieval, transformations, and daedalus inference. where a user cannot access evidence, the system may reveal the existence and relevance of restricted material only when disclosure policy allows; provenance must not become a side channel.

forward trace answers what later relied on an assumption, judgment, or decision. backward trace reconstructs the evidence and reasoning supporting it. branch views show competing interpretations and supersession without flattening disagreement into one folder or one “latest” file.

objects.title: ALEXANDRIA INFORMATION ACCESS AND DISCLOSURE
objects.search_text:
alexandria information access and disclosure docs/j2/alexandria/information_access_and_disclosure.md # alexandria information access and disclosure

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-disclose-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked architectural direction
**owner:** orientation / information governance | **related:** information access, pinakes, collection, daedalus | **cross-reference:** `../information_access_doctrine.md`; `pinakes_portal_and_ux.md`; `daedalus_operating_doctrine.md`

alexandria implements sable harbor's doctrine of maximum useful visibility and minimum necessary restriction. the default is open. restriction follows the nature of information—not rank—and may include personal information, legal privilege, active m&a, narrowly compartmented regulated/federal material, and other genuinely protected classes.

questions are common property. the question remains visible whenever lawful even if evidence or an answer is restricted. questions propagate wider than answers. where appropriate, a user may see “relevant material exists but is restricted” without receiving content, identity, quantity, or inference that defeats the restriction.

restriction creates work: named owner, reason/class, scope, review/challenge route, start/effective time, reconsideration trigger or duration, and lawful disposition. security and iam implement these decisions; they do not redefine the information doctrine as generic least privilege.

collection is pinakes' most heavily provisioned portal because raw material may expose personal, privileged, regulated, commercially sensitive, or source-protection concerns. other portals separate broad visibility of questions/current judgments from entitlement to underlying evidence.

daedalus has universal institutional read authority and bounded disclosure authority. it can know restricted material exists and is relevant but cannot quote, summarize, confirm, deny, aggregate, compare, visualize, or infer restricted content for an unauthorized user. the policy layer evaluates direct and inferential disclosure in the requesting user's context. model/tool access never substitutes for user entitlement.

exact runtime roles, policy engine, redaction mechanism, audit events, inference-leakage tests, and raw collection entitlements remain open implementation. the architecture must demonstrate them before claiming operational enforcement. an access failure that prevented knowledge from reaching an entitled person is studied as an intelligence-system failure, not merely an it ticket.

objects.title: AI AUTHORITY AND HUMAN AUTHORSHIP
objects.search_text:
ai authority and human authorship docs/j2/alexandria/ai_authority_and_human_authorship.md # ai authority and human authorship

**document id:** `sh-j2-alx-ai-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked
**owner:** j2 headquarters / orientation | **related:** daedalus, canon, semaphore, judgment, eib | **cross-reference:** `daedalus_operating_doctrine.md`; `canon_institutional_knowledge.md`; `semaphore_traffic_system.md`

sable harbor wants useful, intellectually aggressive ai. the boundary is institutional authority, not thought. daedalus may form opinions, challenge a user, speculate with a label, propose hypotheses, synthesize evidence, and recommend investigative directions. it may say, “i think you're wrong, and here is why.”

three boundaries are absolute:

1. **no authoritative record write.** daedalus has no write path into authoritative alexandria material.
2. **no self-promotion.** daedalus output cannot automatically become canon, judgment, semaphore, eib, or institutional position.
3. **no institutional authority.** daedalus cannot state “sable harbor judges x” unless accurately quoting a human-authored institutional record.

judgment officers author institutional judgments. orientation officers author semaphore traffic and material canon changes. orientation owns eib publication. ai may aid their research, compare sources, test hypotheses, or prepare private synthetic work, but sable harbor does not create a hidden conveyor in which a human merely approves an ai draft and thereby makes the ai functional author.

independent human authorship requires that the responsible professional understands the question, examines relevant evidence and limitations, makes the judgment, chooses language/confidence, owns dissent treatment, and issues the artifact under their authority. tool assistance is provenance-relevant where material, but the institution records responsibility rather than every private influence chain.

daedalus synthetic reports, timelines, maps, comparisons, notes, and working syntheses may persist in the user's own workspace. they remain outside alexandria, visibly marked `daedalus-generated / non-authoritative`, and have no automatic promotion path. a human may use them to support genuinely human-authored work.

objects.title: DAEDALUS PERSONAL INSTANCE AND INVESTIGATIVE WORKSPACE
objects.search_text:
daedalus personal instance and investigative workspace docs/j2/alexandria/daedalus_personal_instance_and_workspace.md # daedalus personal instance and investigative workspace

**document id:** `sh-j2-daedalus-personal-001` | **version:** 1.0.1 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **revised:** september 6, 2026 | **state:** locked architectural direction
**owner:** j2 headquarters / daedalus doctrine | **related:** ai authorship, access/disclosure, search, visualization | **cross-reference:** `daedalus_operating_doctrine.md`; `information_access_and_disclosure.md`; `visualization_and_branching_history.md`

**revision authority:** the [september 6 canon closeout addendum](../../canon/decision_register_addendum_2026-09-06_closeout.md) replaces tentative spatial/ar wording with alexandria's planned future ar and vr direction. it does not alter daedalus's authority, access, or personal-memory boundaries or rewrite earlier approvals.

each user receives credentials, an individual daedalus instance/context, and persistent segregated memory. years of lawful use should create an exceptionally refined assistant for that person without cross-pollinating conversations, working sets, copied material, private synthesis, or user-specific memory.

system, model, and skill updates may change behavior globally. they do not merge user memory or content. users may deliberately share content-free techniques, settings patterns, prompt/behavior practices, markdown skill files, and workflow templates. a shareable package may not include private memory, copied alexandria extracts, user conversations, or derived content. the principle is **share practice without bypassing discovery**.

## investigative verbs

- **hold:** maintain a user-controlled working set, such as “hold this cable.”
- **pull:** retrieve potentially relevant material across entitled alexandria space when the perfect query is unknown.
- **trace/lineage:** move backward to evidence or forward to later reliance.
- **historical reconstruction:** return to the institution's actual state of knowledge on a specified date without silent hindsight.
- **challenge:** try to disprove a position by surfacing contradiction, dissent, strange assumptions, and overlooked evidence.
- **explore:** identify anomalies and weak/unexpected connections without pretending they are conclusions.
- **compare:** compare periods, business lines, judgments, decisions, assumptions, and branches.
- **visualize:** build timelines, branching histories, connection maps, evidence lineage, and git-like branches of institutional understanding.

alexandria must remain fully usable through an ordinary desktop interface, with future augmented-reality (ar) and virtual-reality (vr) integration planned and supported by its architecture. investigative visualization follows that direction without requiring headsets or spatial hardware for ordinary use. ar/vr is not required for v0.1, and no device, vendor, implementation, or delivery date is promised. this is not a claim of existing ar/vr capability.

all interfaces preserve the same access, disclosure, provenance, temporal-integrity, and authority boundaries. the workspace may persist user-selected synthetic artifacts, all marked non-authoritative and outside alexandria. user export preserves marking, provenance references, and access restrictions. there is no automatic import or promotion back to the authoritative environment.

universal read/bounded disclosure applies throughout. a working set cannot be used to launder restricted content into a less restricted artifact, compare unauthorized populations, or infer protected facts.

objects.title: PINAKES PORTAL AND HUMAN UX
objects.search_text:
pinakes portal and human ux docs/j2/alexandria/pinakes_portal_and_ux.md # pinakes portal and human ux

**document id:** `sh-j2-pinakes-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation / alexandria stewardship | **related:** all alexandria portals, search, daedalus | **cross-reference:** `search_and_historical_reconstruction.md`; `daedalus_personal_instance_and_workspace.md`; `../structured/pinakes_portals.json`

pinakes—named for callimachus's catalog of alexandria—is the **human-facing catalog and portal**, not primarily an invisible ontology. the earlier pharos main-portal concept is superseded.

the nine doors are: **eib archive** (every issued brief across time); **finance** (authorized finance/analysis); **judgment** (live/closed problems and judgments); **jag knowledge** (deployments, interventions, follow-up and reusable lessons); **semaphore** (traffic corpus); **canon** (current and historical institutional understanding); **business lines** (foundry/field, willow, atlas meridian, pale sun/red wash, cradle, aru/bs&t, advisory, emberline history, and canon-supported lines without implying entities); **collection** (authorized underlying contact material); and **education** (mandatory/deep learning, literacy, cases, pathways).

## employee journey

an employee opens current or historical eib, follows an item into its portal, and—where authorized—can source it, trace backward/forward, see correction/supersession, related judgments/decisions, timelines, branches, and point-in-time comparisons. search spans full text, topics, time, business line, status, decisions, problems, and references. rabbit holes are a feature.

daedalus accompanies the user across doors and maintains a user-side working set. it can hold, pull, trace, reconstruct, challenge, compare, explore, and visualize without touching authoritative sources. restricted detail is never disclosed through synthesis or inference.

the machine registry is `../structured/pinakes_portals.json`; it supports this human experience and is not a premature ontology.

## catalog, not dashboard

pinakes answers: where can i enter the institutional record, what kind of material is there, who stewards it, what may i see, and how can i follow it? it does not reduce the company to executive metrics, arrange information by prestige, or pretend that nine tiles are the institution itself. it is the catalog and threshold of alexandria.

the nine doors exist because they are the actual institutional environments sable harbor designed—not because nine is an ontology requirement. adding, removing, or renaming a door therefore requires an institutional decision and registry change, not a ui preference.

## the nine doors

**eib archive** preserves every issued brief with its contemporary links and later supersession. **finance** enters finance records and analytical environments under appropriate controls. **judgment** exposes live and closed problems, judgments, dissent, and appropriate work context. **jag knowledge** carries deployments, interventions, follow-up, field lessons, and reusable practices.

**semaphore** enters durable traffic and its threads. **canon** enters current best institutional understanding and its history. **business lines** enters foundry/foundry field, willow, atlas meridian, pale sun/red wash, cradle, aru/bs&t, advisory, emberline history, and other supported operating worlds without implying separate legal entities. **collection** enters entitled raw/source material and is most heavily gated. **education** enters required and deep learning, business literacy, cases, and pathways.

## continuity of experience

from every item, authorized users can source it, trace backward and forward, see correction/supersession, inspect related judgments/decisions, compare time, and open relevant business or learning context. navigation keeps the user aware of authoritative state, historical point, restrictions, and whether material is institutional or daedalus-generated.

daedalus accompanies rather than occupies a door. its working set can cross portals within disclosure authority, but it cannot alter portal records or become a tenth system. the authoritative item remains untouched while the user explores.

## employee acceptance standard

a new employee who knows only a plain-language concern must be able to enter pinakes, discover the current enterprise questions, locate relevant institutional records, recognize access limits, follow provenance, view the controlled publication, and identify the human owner. if specialist repository knowledge is required, pinakes has failed its human purpose.

objects.title: SEMAPHORE TRAFFIC SYSTEM
objects.search_text:
semaphore traffic system docs/j2/alexandria/semaphore_traffic_system.md # semaphore traffic system

**document id:** `sh-j2-semaphore-001` | **version:** 1.0.1 | **revised:** september 6, 2026 | **state:** locked direction
**owner:** orientation | **related:** canon, judgment, eib, provenance, temporal integrity | **cross-reference:** `provenance_and_lineage.md`; `temporal_integrity.md`; `ai_authority_and_human_authorship.md`

**revision authority:** the [september 6 canon closeout addendum](../../canon/decision_register_addendum_2026-09-06_closeout.md) locks the precedence vocabulary and supersedes the earlier provisional/deferred vocabulary state. the broader runtime implementation remains open; earlier approvals retain their historical scope.

semaphore is the cable-like longitudinal intelligence/decision traffic medium: durable, searchable, threaded, referential, supersession-aware, historically navigable, and human-authored. it is not slack with formal typography and not a one-page cap on major decisions.

traffic retains durable id, human originator, issue/event time, subject stating why it matters, concise point-first opening, references/thread, distribution/access, business line/topics, related decisions/problems, corrections/supersession, and handling precedence where useful. routine / priority / immediate / flash are the locked precedence labels. orientation officers exercise professional judgment over what merits traffic; policy does not enumerate every allowed subject.

the record captures decisions, relied-upon judgments, alternatives, assumptions, unknowns, dissent, evidence references, predictions, triggers, later changes, and supersession—not every hallway conversation, private thought, or interpersonal influence chain. retention follows future legal/privacy rules while preserving provenance wherever lawful.

ai may assist research; only a human orientation officer writes/issues institutional traffic. daedalus cannot author, issue, or promote a cable.

## institutional purpose

semaphore carries the institution's evolving understanding across time and organizational distance. it is not chat, email, a ticket queue, a document repository, or a one-page decision memo. a cable can report a change, anomaly, field condition, consequential interpretation, correction, dissent, decision context, or other matter that an orientation officer judges worthy of durable institutional traffic. the medium remains broad because professional judgment—not an eligibility checklist—determines what deserves a cable.

## cable construction

the subject tells a reader why the traffic matters rather than merely naming a project. the opening states the point concisely. the body preserves enough context, evidence references, assumptions, confidence, alternatives, unknowns, and dissent for a future reader to understand the issue without pretending one cable is the entire record.

a durable cable id never changes. origin identifies the human issuing office/officer. event, issue, and record times remain distinguishable. distribution reflects information nature and need, not prestige. references create explicit threads across earlier/later cables, judgment problems, decisions, canon states, eib items, jag deployments, finance assumptions, and source material.

## handling precedence

the four precedence levels express handling urgency only:

| level | meaning |
|---|---|
| routine | handle through the normal reading and response cycle. |
| priority | expedite; waiting for the normal cycle could materially impair a decision. |
| immediate | interrupt normal work for prompt attention; an active situation needs a timely response. |
| flash | exceptional, time-critical traffic where delay could cause severe, imminent consequences. |

precedence does not establish truth, confidence, author seniority, permanent importance, or authority to command. a routine cable may be strategically profound; a flash cable may contain uncertain information. precedence does not change distribution, access restrictions, human authorship, or the authority of the underlying record.

foundational doctrine sets no fixed response-time targets or service-level promises. operational procedures may define justified response targets without changing the meaning of these labels.

cable metadata and search/catalog representations use this accepted vocabulary wherever precedence is represented. historical records retain the vocabulary and state actually recorded at the time; the new decision does not silently backfill missing precedence or rewrite earlier traffic. contact's separate flash / current / active / standing collection-tempo vocabulary is not resolved by this decision.

## threading, correction, and supersession

a reply or follow-on references the earlier cable while remaining its own record. a correction states what was wrong, what changes, why, and which downstream readers or artifacts may be affected. supersession identifies the new controlling traffic without making the prior cable disappear. a cable may remain historically significant even when its conclusion is wrong.

thread navigation supports chronological reading, branch/alternative interpretation, forward reliance, backward sourcing, and related-topic traversal. traffic concerning `transportation scheduling`, for example, remains discoverable across years even when authors used different project names.

## authorship and accountability

the orientation officer exercises judgment about issue, framing, distribution, and record state and is accountable for the issued traffic. ai can retrieve, compare, challenge, and support research, but an officer must independently understand and author the cable. there is no “approve generated draft” process that makes daedalus the hidden institutional author.

semaphore records the institutional mind—not a forensic influence map. it preserves relied-upon judgments, assumptions, dissent, alternatives, predictions, and change. it does not attempt to capture every conversation or assign later blame for private interpersonal influence.

objects.title: CANON — INSTITUTIONAL KNOWLEDGE CORPUS
objects.search_text:
canon — institutional knowledge corpus docs/j2/alexandria/canon_institutional_knowledge.md # canon — institutional knowledge corpus

**document id:** `sh-j2-canon-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked
**owner:** orientation | **related:** judgment, eib, semaphore, temporal integrity, provenance | **cross-reference:** `temporal_integrity.md`; `provenance_and_lineage.md`; `ai_authority_and_human_authorship.md`

canon means: **what sable harbor can responsibly say it knows at this point in time.** it is living, versioned current best understanding, not eternal certainty; uncertainty can itself be canonical. orientation owns canon and judgment supplies much of its analytical basis.

for a material change, one orientation officer authors the proposed institutional change and a second reviews/stress-tests it. if material disagreement cannot be resolved, the head/director of orientation breaks the deadlock. there is no standing canon committee. every superseded state remains accessible with time, evidence, dissent, and change reason.

## “we know this now”

canon gives sable harbor an explicit present-tense institutional read. it prevents the company from hiding behind permanent ambiguity while also refusing false certainty. a canonical statement may say that evidence is incomplete, confidence is bounded, interpretations remain disputed, or an important question is unresolved. those are institutional knowledge states, not editorial failures.

canon distinguishes observation, evidence, warranted judgment, adopted institutional understanding, assumption, and unknown. it does not transform an authoritative source for one purpose into universal physical truth. a ledger may canonically establish what was recorded; it may not establish what physically occurred without additional evidence.

## entry and material change

judgment commonly supplies analytical basis, but a judgment does not automatically become canon. the originating orientation officer states the proposed knowledge change, prior state, evidence and provenance, confidence, material dissent, scope, effective time, and downstream consequences. a second officer independently stress-tests it. the head resolves a material editorial deadlock without becoming a czar of truth.

materiality depends on whether the change could alter important enterprise questions, decisions, finance assumptions, operating models, risk envelopes, education, or interpretation of prior events—not word count or executive interest.

## supersession and intellectual history

a new state links to the one it supersedes. the former state remains accessible with the evidence and reasoning then available. later explanation is layered as later knowledge. canon never silently backfills history or deletes a dissent because one view eventually prevailed.

downstream owners receive notice or discoverable linkage when a material canon change affects an eib item, decision, model, control, course, or live judgment problem. orientation owns the institutional knowledge state; accountable operating functions still own their decisions and execution.

## negative authority

canon is not a command, vote, legal conclusion beyond its sources, or substitute for operating accountability. daedalus cannot write or promote itself into canon. no committee votes truth into existence, and no executive can make evidence settled merely by repeating it.

objects.title: DAEDALUS OPERATING DOCTRINE AND AI AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES
objects.search_text:
daedalus operating doctrine and ai authority boundaries docs/j2/alexandria/daedalus_operating_doctrine.md # daedalus operating doctrine and ai authority boundaries

**document id:** `sh-j2-daedalus-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **state:** locked architectural direction
**owner:** j2 headquarters / daedalus doctrine | **related:** human authorship, disclosure, personal workspace | **cross-reference:** `ai_authority_and_human_authorship.md`; `daedalus_personal_instance_and_workspace.md`

daedalus is the personally provisioned ai agent around alexandria—not alexandria and not pinakes door ten. it may traverse, retrieve/pull, hold, compare, trace/lineage, historically reconstruct, visualize, synthesize, challenge, explore, converse, form labeled opinions, and recommend investigation. it may say, “i think you're wrong, and here is why.” its rule is **intellectual aggression without institutional authority**.

## hard boundaries

1. **no authoritative write.** no write path into alexandria's institutional record.
2. **no self-promotion.** a synthesis/opinion never automatically becomes canon, judgment, semaphore, eib, or institutional position.
3. **no institutional authority.** it cannot say sable harbor judges something unless quoting an actual human-authored record.

judgment officers author judgments; orientation officers author semaphore and canon changes; orientation owns eib publication. there is no hidden approve-an-ai-draft conveyor. daedalus synthetic reports, timelines, comparisons, visualizations, and research notes may persist in a user's workspace but remain clearly marked synthetic, non-authoritative, and outside alexandria; a human may independently use them in authored work.

each user has credentials, individual context, and segregated persistent memory. no cross-user conversation, working-set, copied-material, synthesis, or memory access. global system/model/skill updates may change behavior without merging content. users may deliberately share content-free techniques, skills, settings, markdown skill files, and workflow templates—never private memory or alexandria extracts. user export preserves synthetic marking and access constraints.

## universal read; bounded disclosure

daedalus may read the full alexandria environment so it can identify relevance, including that restricted material exists. disclosure is evaluated for the requesting user and context. restricted content and disallowed inferences cannot leak merely because the model read them. the runtime policy layer, entitlement implementation, inference-leakage tests, logging, and redaction controls are acceptance requirements; this v0.1 doctrine does not claim a runtime exists.

the testable policy manifest is `../structured/daedalus_policy.json`.

receipt and assay at the modeled licensed conversion-facility delivery point. a
qualified third-party carrier transports the product under the modeled shipper and
custody controls.

## 8. operating authority

`locked`: pale sun first; proving ground second. foundry, willow, atlas, j2, ess, and
other sable harbor institutions may support bounded work only through a named pale sun
operating owner, qualification gates, explicit stop/rollback conditions, and preserved
evidence. they do not displace red wash operating authority.

cole's temporary-stop authority creates an operational disposition; it does not make
a claim true. the synthetic 2025 stop record therefore keeps observation, judgment,
authority, action, later evidence, and remaining uncertainty separate.

## 9. aru/bs&t acquisition and industrial interface

the controlling bridge is `sh-ps-rw-log-001`.

`locked` boundaries:

- american resource utility (aru) and blood, sweat & tears railway (bs&t) had no
  pre-existing commercial relationship with red wash;
- qualified external carriers serve every 2025 red wash movement;
- a real soft, costly, uneven freight backdrop supports—but does not prove—the
  fictional carrier-consolidation and lane-allocation event;
- the resulting scheduling disruption creates delivery risk but no lost 2025 annual
  sales and no change to 2025 annual revenue;
- the search begins with replacement carriers, broadens to rail mapping, and the
  question “whose line is this?” surfaces aru/bs&t through operating analysis;
- at discovery, there is no direct mine connection, suitable secure transload, or
  demonstrated uranium-specific aru/bs&t capability;
- $15.0m is an unbooked ceiling; $8.5m phase 1 is approved, with $3.25m owned by red wash and $5.25m by aru; and
- no aru/bs&t uranium custody or service begins automatically.

acquisition diligence occurs in november–december 2025. months 0–3 are confirmatory post-close condition work; months 3–6 cover engineering and approvals. selected ordinary industrial-input service starts july 7, 2026, after the corresponding synthetic commissioning gates. months 12–18 remain a future mature-integration review. mixed external-carrier, truck, transload and rail service remains permissible.

the full aru/bs&t case is implemented in the industrial successor; direct uranium custody remains open. aru closes january 7, 2026 after q4 2025 discovery. the 2025 baseline remains separate from the partial service year and normalized annual plans. see `industrial/readme.md` for sources, registers, reconciliations and the participant corpus.

## 10. approved visual sources

the four original approved pngs remain byte-identical under `assets/brand/red_wash_visual_manifest.json`. pale sun and red wash logo originals remain current. the two carbon county maps are superseded historical originals; their old site, elevation, operator and rail/loadout annotations must not appear as current geography. current maps are separately generated from the sweetwater county anchor and industrial gis sources, with their own hashes and explicit supersession metadata.

## 11. public/private boundary

the public repository contains the company-visible evidence and selected decision
case. nonpublic evaluation material remains outside this repository. any companion
must bind to the exact final public merge commit and source hashes after merge; this
record does not claim that the binding already exists.

## 12. superseded and open scope

earlier exploratory values of $24.7m revenue, $22.3m generic operating cost, 126
employees, $18.5m aro, and exploratory acquisition financing are `superseded` and may
not feed the selected package. the legal identities and aru selected case are resolved in this successor. direct uranium custody, future mine spur and expansion commissioning dates remain gated.

## 13. geographic and funding reconciliation

red wash's selected fictional anchor is 42.2200° n, 108.1800° w in sweetwater county, north of wamsutter in the great divide basin. the dem screening elevation is approximately 6,885 ft. derived drill coordinates use nad83 / utm 12n (epsg:26912), centered on 732,748.781991 m e, 4,678,053.610642 m n. legacy collar coordinates remain in the archived 1.0 source/build revision. terrain, geology and resource evidence remain synthetic; a real county boundary does not validate a fictional deposit.

the preserved standalone 2026 inventory model derives $1,522,479 operating cash flow and −$7,477,521 free cash flow after $9,000,000 existing capital spending. the separately authorized $3,250,000 mine interface allocation is additional. the integrated successor includes this capital, the aro rollforward, modeled reclamation cash, intercompany invoices, external origin linehaul, depreciation and tax effects. the industrial financing ledger funds its cash requirement; equity receipts are financing, never revenue. future 225,000/300,000-ton cases require explicit daily-capacity and operating-calendar upgrades beyond a 600-ton/day plant.

american resource utility, inc. remains independently viable as an acquired group.

taylor is the fictional yard, shop and transload hub. wamsutter supplies real-reference
union pacific interchange context. the selected bs&t network is approximately

structures, industrial access and facility boundaries.

## demand, storage and service

the annual planning allowance is 225 inbound car equivalents: 205 base commodity
cars, ten project cars and ten conditional buffer cars. the 300-car figure is design
capacity. neither buffer nor unused capacity creates an invoice or a volume promise.
the commodity register separates acid, binder, lime, steel, mro and projects; aggregate
is locally sourced and fuel begins truck-delivered. product concentrate is excluded.

the operating model translates payload and commodity consumption into tonnage,
truck trips, usable storage, replenishment batches and the 10–14-day critical-stock
requirement. capacity and buffer assumptions are explicitly synthetic engineering
inputs. they are not manufacturer certificates or evidence of licensed operation.

tuesday and friday are scheduled handling windows, within the five-day railway
service. dispatch exception moves protect the elapsed-hour sla for off-window
arrivals; a 96-hour friday-to-tuesday gap cannot be disguised as 72 business hours.
the ordinary-input default is 72 hours from interchange receipt to empty release,
with a 36–48-hour operating goal and a 96-hour steel maximum. the calendar model
measures arrivals, handling, release and exception costs. acid/binder service targets
95% on time. cause-based demurrage and each custodian's timestamp remain explicit.

september 5 cutoff; future maturity review and expansion are not completed events.

separate from this interface. the original mine's $4 million sustaining and $5 million
rehabilitation budgets do not conceal its new $3.25 million interface investment.
the successor funding schedule distinguishes operating cash, parent equity, debt,
fees, capital and working capital. equity contributions are financing, never revenue.

## commercial and custody controls

the five-year agreement uses separately identified railway, terminal and trucking
charges, annual indexing/review and cost-to-serve support. the final selected rate
card follows the model's costs and benchmark limitations; the earlier $875,000 revenue
and $365,000 incremental ebitda figures are comparison anchors, not required plugs.
external class i linehaul is distinguished from aru revenue. no service price is
represented as an actual tariff quote or third-party bid.

there is no minimum-volume guarantee, hidden operating subsidy, automatic preference
or prohibition on outside carriers. red wash and aru keep separate p&ls; invoices,
receivables/payables and intercompany expense/revenue eliminate at the industrial
consolidation boundary. capital allocation remains visible rather than being hidden
inside railway pricing. customer return and multi-customer investment justify the
taylor asset case; red wash does not retrospectively justify the entire acquisition.

direct uranium custody remains open_gated. the gate register assigns material,
packaging, route, custody, training, emergency-response, insurance, commercial and
customer requirements to their actual responsible parties. a blanket invented nrc
carrier license is not a substitute for that role analysis. qualified external
carriers remain permanently permissible. government permits, license replicas and
regulatory approvals are not fabricated by this record.

## current evidence navigation

- [operating source](../../industrial/source/operations.json): capacities, facilities,
  equipment, represented crafts, safety history, rates and the modeled sla calendar.
- [finance source](../../industrial/source/finance.json): acquisition and operating

facilities or the acquired company's selected financial baseline.

importance, author seniority, or authority to command. a routine message can be strategically

conversation to determine current canon. once accepted, that record and its stated
supersession scope control. a commit alone does not create approval, and an approved draft
alone does not establish completed repository integration.

closeout evidence identifies the accepted commit or pr, controlling records, delivered artifact
paths or release urls, applicable validation results, and any remaining limits. closing a
decision issue does not claim that separately deferred implementation has been delivered.
this repository policy records the owner's approval; it does not invent an in-universe board
meeting, consent, or ratification.

## 2. repository-wide artifact disposition

| material | location and treatment |
|---|---|
| canonical documents, code, schemas, configuration, generators | versioned in git. preserve source identifiers, status, and lineage. |
| approved source artwork and canonical visual references | versioned in git with provenance and rights information. an approved source-artwork exception, including the controlling j2 pngs, remains explicit. |
| controlled corporate pdfs and publications | versioned in git alongside their source lineage. regenerate from accepted source; reconcile versions, manifests, and hashes. a publication does not independently create canon. |
| complete distributable zip packages and other packaged bundles | new versions belong in indexed github releases, with version identifiers, manifests, and sha-256 checksums. do not add duplicate current package bytes to the git tree by default. |
| convenience renders and previews | temporary by default. retain a useful review or evidence render deliberately, with its purpose and source identified; it acquires no independent authority. |
| temporary previews, intermediate renders, caches, build debris | exclude from git unless deliberately retained as evidence. local generation is a working step, not delivery. |
| generated institutional json/sqlite catalogs | keep their current in-tree placement and existing regeneration rules while issue #37 remains open. this policy does not decide their complete lifecycle. |

the narrow historical zip exceptions in section 4 justify retaining the existing bytes in-tree.
they do not make the default for new distributable versions ambiguous. controlled individual
publications remain in-tree even when a release bundle also includes them.

## 3. release identity, discovery, and corrections

every controlled release package must be discoverable from the repository's
[controlled-document index](../controlled_document_index.md), directly or through an indexed
release record, and retrievable from its recorded release location. that record identifies the
version/tag, source commit and relevant canon snapshot, package asset names, manifests,
sha-256 checksums, limitations, and supersession or historical status where applicable.
github's automatically generated source-code archive is not a substitute for a deliberately
assembled controlled package.

preserve published package identity and bytes. corrections receive a new version and changelog;
they do not silently replace an old zip under its existing name. any later relocation must
verify destination bytes against the recorded hash, update navigation, and retain provenance
and disposition flags. a move is complete only after destination retrieval and checksum
verification. this policy does not claim that such a migration has occurred or authorize bulk
deletion of historical artifacts.

the [finance release process](../commercialization/release_process.md) continues to govern
finance-specific builds, source locks, safety checks, and package manifests. its published
snapshots are not rewritten to incorporate a later canon decision. a successor release must
record its own source scope and boundaries.

## 4. existing package disposition and release index

new local download or revalidation of their internal manifests.

reviewed, versioned package with the current approved assets.

keeping this previously delivered package preserves existing links and audit/training history
without rewriting its bytes. its source manifest supplies no separate distribution-state

zip hash is newly inventoried here because the briefing manifest inventories individual

assert that its modeled or open facets became canon or that the seven evidence packages

### 4.4 historical audit and future inventory changes
